summary: F30 re-review MINOR 4. ErrAllFamiliesExhausted arrives wrapped in ErrCycleLevelFailure (the sequential handleCycleError relies on it). The cycle-run root walks any cycle-level failure (cmd_cycle.go) and the sequential loop applies the failure walk BEFORE its quota pause (cmd_loop_sequential_dispatch.go), bumping the item's failure_count for a system limit; the resume root returns exit 5 before its closeout, keeping the claims for the resumed attempt. Resume's order is probably the right one — a quota pause is resumable and charging the item punishes it for a system limit — but the three roots disagree.
